Class CacheService

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.services.cache.CacheService
public class CacheService extends Object

Implements a service providing object caching. This cache is three level tree. The first level is the root (implemented via the Hashtable handlers), the second level are the handlers themselves, object which implement the CacheHandler interface. From every handler hang all the objects (of the same class) stored into it. Every individual object is identified by a String key from a handler, or from a (className, key) pair for the top of the tree.

    • get

      public static Object get(String objectClass, String key) throws CacheException
      Gets an Object from the cache. In principle it is not guaranteed that the object returned belongs to the class requested, or that it IS a Collection of objects from that class. TODO: Get this to be true. Implement checkings in "put" operation and maybe in "get".... See performance considerations.
      Parameters:
      objectClass - The class of the object trying to be retrieved. This value is going to be used to lookup a CacheHandler object, responsible for the final storage.
      key - The name of the object to be retrieved. It might be an Entity PK or a ModelBeanSearch signature (in this case returning a Collection).
      Returns:
      The Object if found, null else.
      Throws:
      CacheException - If a problem (like when there is no handler for the class) is found.

      public static void set(String objectClass, String key, Object o) throws CacheException
      Stores an Object into the cache. Right now no checkings are made that the object belongs to the class (or is a Collection of objects of that class.
      Parameters:
      objectClass - The class of the object. Used to lookup the handler.
      key - The key under the object will be stored.
      o - The object itself to store.
      Throws:
      CacheException - If a problem (like when there is no handler for the class) is found.

    • setModelBeanCollection

      public static void setModelBeanCollection(String beanClass, Collection c) throws CacheException
      Store the individual beans of a Collection by their primary keys. With this enabled, a primary key search will return a hit, after some other query which included this bean. This method will be called for DAOService.find(search) operations whose search has the storeSearchResults attribute to true;
      Parameters:
      beanClass - The class of the ModelBean included in the Collection
      c - The collection of the ModelBeans
      Throws:
      CacheException - If the handler is not found or any of the objects inside the collection is not an ModelBean
      See Also:
      • ModelBeanSearch
